correctness.rationale: Connectedness forces equal two-step firing counts by the Laplacian kernel, hence genuine two-cycles alternate every vertex. The exact integer chip intervals yield a product count per firing set; direct independent simulation of 296272 finite confined configurations matched four small graph orbit populations. For r>=3 the normalized log-weight is negative Bernoulli relative entropy, with unique maximum at half-firing; its Hessian has eigenvalues 16 and 4((r-2)/(r-1))^2. Pinsker gives global Gaussian tail domination and Stirling/Riemann sums give the integral prefactor 1/(4alpha^(r-1)) for orbits and inverse-Hessian covariance. Finite tests are not used as the proof of any infinite-n assertion.

value.rationale: It computes the natural joint firing-population distribution under the intrinsic uniform primitive-recurrent-orbit measure on a full infinite family of equal-shore multipartite networks. The entropy ridge at r=2 becomes a strictly convex Gaussian saddle at every fixed r>=3; the resulting covariance, anticorrelation and exact normalized orbit-growth constant are nontrivial structural statistics that do not follow by merely replacing parameters in the bipartite formula. It does not claim a new general two-periodicity criterion or downstream application.
